title: Search
name: Name
nameTip: Separate several patterns with spaces. * stands for any number of characters, ? for exactly one. Without *, every name that contains the text matches.
textTip: Searches inside text and source files. Upper and lower case do not matter.
hiddenTip: Files and folders whose name starts with a dot.
sizeTip: A number on its own counts in MB. With a unit, 300 KB or 2.5 GB work too.
saveTip: The search goes into the menu of the search field and always shows the current hits when clicked
unknownHint: I understand width, height, codec, artist, camera, size, modified, duration and every column name, for example
nothingHint: Another folder or fewer conditions might find more
nameWinTip: This is what the search is called in the menu of the search field.
savedToast: “{name}” is now in the search field
menuNone: Type a pattern and save it with the button in the field.

examples.mkv: every MKV file, in subfolders too
examples.one: a ? stands for exactly one character
examples.meta: 4K films in HEVC, from the metadata
examples.week: everything that changed in the last 7 days
